---
title: "Bootstrap Explorer — SAP Customer ROE"
---

This app accompanies the [section on the bootstrap](inference_01_sampling-distributions.qmd#sec-bootstrap). It shows the actual sample from the Nucleus study — 81 firms, each with its ROE — and resamples those 81 firms with replacement one draw at a time, so you can see which firms repeat, which sit out, and how much the resample mean moves. The resample means accumulate into the bootstrap approximation to the sampling distribution of the sample mean, which you can compare against the normal curve. The app runs in your browser and takes a few moments to start.

[Open the bootstrap explorer](https://jaredsmurray.github.io/stats-webapps/sap_bootstrap.html){target="_blank"}
